method: Independent model reassessment of all ten exact narrowed source/rendering/synset proposals; not native-human certification. Original Spanish raw-line hashes and selected senses independently checked against pinned gzip; exact WordNet noun and MCR lemma lines verified locally. Prior decisions remain archival and are not silently overwritten.

limitations: These are newly corroborated selected-sense approvals, not ten proven new runtime spellings; deduplicate against active providers.
Keep narrowed contexts and source identities; no new plural/female derivative or verb/adjective authorization.
Derived English renderings are model-reviewed and combine licensed sources, not verbatim dictionary-provided translations or Mexican-only senses.
Raw Spanish grammatical gender is not independently verified and should not be claimed as reviewed merely from these approvals.
No source quotations/examples/media copied into this review; no production files changed.
